senses.gloss:
mn. (-ण्डः-ण्डं)
A bow.
m. (-ण्डः)
1 An eyebrow.
2 The name of a country.
E.
कुण to sound, अण्ड Uṇādi affix, &c. दन् inserted; the final radical consonant is rejected; otherwise, कुद to speak false, अण्डच् aff.

n. (-वं)
A species of grain eaten by the poorer people, (Paspalum kora.)
E.
क wind, उद्रव to go, affix अच्; sown by the wind, or growing wild in many places.
